title: A finite physical return contract cannot demand an exponential clock
statement: Statewise occupation hierarchy gives E_x tau0^p<=C_p t_p^M for every finite p, and positive zero-return has all polynomial moments after actual initial Exp(kappa0) holding. For each member and every s>0, however, E exp(sT0+) is INFINITE. Translated neutral cells (0,n,n)+{yj} avoid any fixed return state; full designated-cycle transform product_j r_j(n)/(Q_j(n)-s) tends to kappa0/(kappa0-s)>1 for0<s<kappa0. Repeating cycles after an irreducible positive-probability prefix forces divergence; initial holding already covers s>=kappa0. At k3/unit rates ordinary pi=exp(-3)/(A!B!C!) and exact cell exit-flux/mass~2/n force zero Poincare/Dirichlet gap; no assertion about every nonreversible spectral notion. Strong stationary Poisson-like inventory tails do not imply an exponential physical return or mixing gap. Earlier admitted-scope multiplicative theorem remains intact and is not extended to this refused family. Ordinary product-Poisson,strong-endotactic/scaled-volume,multi-step tier and shell-extrema methods retain their precise stronger/different hypotheses; no universal dismissal or historical novelty claim. General weak reversibility still lacks an earned common receiver/anchor/finite debt-repayment classification across interacting neutral layers. Third-party PDFs/text copies remain private; original provenance/rights linked,not new Astra work.
